about.what: Expected answers for the draft 4 page (DRAFT4.md sections 1, 5.12, 9), computed outside the app's code.
about.data_note: All data is simulated for the Texas MISA case competition. It is not Costco data.

rules.service: mean chance_met over open blocks (plan), mean chance_met_draft (draft); delta (plan - draft) x 100 in points
rules.below_goal: plan: CSV below_service_goal; draft: reproduced as open and chance_met_draft < goal - 0.0005
rules.people: sum of recommended (plan) / draft_scheduled_employees (draft) over open blocks; delta % = change / draft, Math.round
rules.cost: sum of cost / cost_draft over open blocks; delta % = change / draft, Math.round
rules.p2_worst: lowest chance among P1, then largest need - plan, then key ascending
rules.list_order: P1 by chance ascending, need - plan descending, key ascending
rules.p3: open and draft unfilled > 0 (plan_vs_draft.csv 'unfilled' is the draft's)
rules.all_cell: number = sum plan over 3 warehouses; tier from lowest chance; warm if any below goal; w2 if any below-goal chance < 0.80; pips = warehouses below goal
rules.formats: DRAFT4.md 5.12 with JavaScript Math.round semantics; U+2212 for minus; compact money = one decimal of thousands

notes: Plan below goal: taken from plan_vs_draft.csv below_service_goal; it agrees with the rule chance_met < goal - 0.0005 on 567 of 567 rows (0 mismatches).
Per-block chance for text, tiers, list order and the P2 pick is chance_met rounded to 6 places, as the API serializes it (the page reads the API). below_goal stays the full-precision flag.
Draft below goal: the CSV has no flag, so it is reproduced with the server's rule as DRAFT4.md states it: open and chance_met_draft < goal - 0.0005.
need (for Short and the P2 tie-break) is parsed from outputs/explanations.csv 'why' ('It needs N people ...'), which the pipeline writes for every below-goal block; missing for 0 below-goal blocks.
